items: The finance team prepared a ____ forecast before presenting the expansion plan to investors.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'realistic forecast'.
The hotel received ____ feedback from guests after renovating its conference rooms.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'favorable feedback'.
The supplier agreed to provide ____ documentation for every shipment of medical equipment.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'comprehensive documentation'.
The factory introduced new controls to reduce ____ waste during the packaging process.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'excessive waste'.
The board requested an ____ assessment of the merger proposal before voting on it.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'independent assessment'.
The airport authority issued a ____ warning about delays caused by the approaching storm.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'severe warning'.
The project manager set ____ deadlines for each phase of the software migration.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'attainable deadlines'.
The museum will conduct a ____ review of its emergency evacuation procedures next month.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'thorough review'.
The consultant identified a ____ opportunity to reduce shipping costs without changing carriers.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'significant opportunity'.
The restaurant maintains ____ records of food temperatures for all refrigerated storage areas.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'accurate records'.
The bank introduced ____ measures to protect customers from unauthorized account access.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'stringent measures'.
The design team needs a more ____ estimate of material costs before finalizing the budget.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'precise estimate'.
The company expects ____ growth in online orders during the holiday season.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'steady growth'.
The laboratory follows ____ guidelines when storing samples that require refrigeration.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'strict guidelines'.
The sales director asked for ____ evidence that the new pricing strategy had improved retention.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'convincing evidence'.
The property manager scheduled ____ inspections after several tenants reported water damage.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'regular inspections'.
The retailer has seen ____ interest in its subscription service since the loyalty program launched.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'considerable interest'.
The legal department requested ____ information about the vendor's data-handling practices.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'additional information'.
The manufacturer announced ____ changes to the warranty policy after reviewing customer complaints.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'substantial changes'.
The training program gives new supervisors ____ experience in resolving workplace conflicts.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'practical experience'.
The committee reached a ____ decision after reviewing all three bids.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'unanimous decision'.
The warehouse manager reported ____ damage to several cartons after the delivery truck arrived.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'extensive damage'.
The software update includes ____ improvements to the search and reporting functions.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'noticeable improvements'.
The insurer requires ____ proof of ownership before processing claims for high-value equipment.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'documentary proof'.
The marketing team developed a ____ message for the product launch across all regional channels.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'consistent message'.
